subtitles.en: Give me a sense here, um, kind of like what people wake up to tomorrow with regards to sort of, you know, how they sort of trade in and out of this, whether it's through your ETFs or through the stocks themselves.
subtitles.zh: 请给我一个概念，比如人们明天醒来时会如何看待，无论是通过ETF还是权益资产本身，他们如何进出市场。

subtitles.en: Well, the first thing to point out is that there's been a lot of volatility this earnings season in particular. And of course, we've just come off the back of, you know, a very brutal month, which is July from a momentum stocks, particularly a lot of the semi stocks.
subtitles.zh: 首先需要指出的是，本财报季波动很大。而且我们刚刚经历了七月份，对动量股尤其是半导体股来说，那是非常残酷的一个月。

subtitles.en: Of course, I think it was the worst July for the NASDAQ for 22 years. So in that environment, you know, you've had earnings, the Google earnings, for example, spring to mind where, you know, for all intensive purposes, the numbers were amazing, but was slightly higher, capex, then the market expected the shares took a dive.
subtitles.zh: 当然，我认为这是纳斯达克22年来最糟糕的七月。在这种环境下，比如谷歌的财报，数字非常亮眼，但资本支出略高于市场预期，股价就下跌了。

subtitles.en: And subsequently, you know, recovered. I think we've seen that playbook in past earnings. And I think what we might be going through with AMD right now is similar.
subtitles.zh: 随后股价又回升了。我认为过去的财报中我们见过这种模式，而AMD现在可能也在经历类似情况。

subtitles.en: I haven't had time to digest the earnings as of right now, but I suspect it's a little bit of an overreaction.
subtitles.zh: 我还没来得及消化财报，但我怀疑市场有点反应过度。

subtitles.en: To perhaps a number that was the market of price to perfection, that maybe there was some detail off.
subtitles.zh: 可能市场对完美定价，但细节上有些偏差。

subtitles.en: But the one thing that we typically see in the business is we see a lot of activity, people trading in these levity TFS in the pre and post market.
subtitles.zh: 但我们在业务中通常看到的是，在盘前和盘后，人们交易这些杠杆ETF非常活跃。

subtitles.en: So we get activity coming out of Asia overnight. And that's the great thing about lot of ETFs, which not everybody knows you can trade in the pre and post markets.
subtitles.zh: 所以我们从亚洲隔夜获得交易活动。这就是很多ETF的好处，不是所有人都知道可以在盘前和盘后交易。

winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
